title: Allen D. Haynie
vital_facts: Baptized as a child, Aaronic Priesthood as a Youth, Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult.
Missionary in the Argentina Cordoba Mission, 1977-79.
Married Deborah Ruth Hall on Dec. 19, 1983, in the Salt Lake Temple; six children.
Bachelor's from BYU in Political Science, minor in English; Juris Doctorate from BYU.
Clerkship for Federal 9th Circuit Court of Appeals; partner with Latham and Watkins law firm; partner in Haynie Law Group.
EQ President, Ward Young Men President, Seminary Teacher, Bishop, High Councilor, Stake President.
Area President in the North America West Area.
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
